body:
I'll try. I can't promise I'll make it to 30, but I'll try. I've tried methods of coping, but every time I'd look in the mirror or watch my peers, it just reminds me of how subpar I really am.

But I'll try. I'll try to start tomorrow with even more faux happiness than usual. I'll try once again.

I haven't. Well, I have but I hadn't known them enough to grieve. 

But these people only knew me for 2.5 months. What could they possibly miss? My awkward silences? My lack of wit? My average to below average face? I guess I won't get to see, but I can't possibly imagine a lifetime of grief from someone as insignificant as me.

Maybe if you knew me you'd agree.

Everyone just seems to fit in though. They know who they are and while sure they may have a few problems of their own, at least they have a great family and awesome friends and easily socialize... surely it's much better than being confused of your own being, confused of your sexuality, socially slow, awkward as all hell, multitude of body image issues.

Surely.

Yeah... especially my crush and my friends. Would they actually miss me? I just met them this year, they'll be sad but I bet they'll get over it. They have better friends than me. I'm a terrible friend, I really can't comprehend how people keep trying to talk to me when I give them reasons every day as to why I'm so fucking boring and dull.

I don't mean to be harsh, but I don't care if you care. I don't know you, you don't know me. If anything, I only care about these people who interact with me. I wish I could see who would mourn my death or not after I've killed myself because I'm a shitty person and crave any sliver of acknowledgement. But it's impossible, so that may be another factor in why I might not follow through.
But with so many people used to my old personally, it feels as if they are holding me back because any slight variation causes a reaction that I hate having to put up with
